axes.name: mapsym_array_view
axes.rationale: MAPSYM independently names _MapB at DGROUP:48E8; nearby recovered users (AddWater, ExpAddAnt, GetExitDirB, FixExitMapB draft) declare it as unsigned char near MapB[64][64]. Test that evidenced same-TU view against the isolated flat declaration.

axes.name: typed_array_flattening
axes.rationale: Preserve the same 0..0xFFF byte span and row+cell offset while expressing the 64x64 MAPSYM as a byte pointer or its first row; these forms can affect register allocation through C7 expression/lvalue lowering.
